summary: L'Anse aux Meadows National Historic Site is well-supported as a UNESCO World Heritage site featuring 1,000-year-old Norse archaeological remains and sod-house reconstructions. The 2026 operational season is confirmed from June 1 to October 2. While regional travel details (St. Anthony airport and driving times) are standard for the area, they were not explicitly contained in the provided Parks Canada technical bulletins. The location's rugged geography and trail system are verified.
